body: Frontier Airlines has announced a new first class will roll out beginning March 5, 2027. Along with that, Frontier will install power outlets at each seat, along with Starlink WiFi, and the retrofits begin this month. A leaked internal document shared with View From The Wing revealed the changes and their timeline: each plane will get eight of the new first class seats, in a two-by-two configuration for the first two rows of the plane, and every plane in the Frontier fleet is from the Airbus A320 series, with new Airbus A320neo and Airbus A321neo aircraft being received.

Frontier will sell first class seats on the reconfigured aircraft as UpFront Plus seats prior to the launch, as planes are fitted with the new seats, though no cabin service changes will be made until the official rollout. During the retrofit, Frontier's seating page will tell passengers whether the seats up front will be the new first class or the old UpFront Plus, which was a row of standard economy seats with extra legroom and the middle seat blocked.

Frontier chose Geven's Comoda model for its new 21-inch-wide first class seats, which were first displayed at the annual Aircraft Interiors Expo in Hamburg, Germany. Frontier originally announced a new first class in 2024, to debut in 2025, but that has been delayed. Frontier has not announced any pricing for Starlink, and the memo did not specify what type of power outlets will be installed, while US competitors Southwest Airlines and United Airlines offer Starlink for free through sponsorships to members of their frequent flyer programs.
en.summary: Frontier Airlines will roll out its new first class beginning March 5, 2027, with retrofits starting this month: eight first class seats per plane, power outlets at every seat, and Starlink WiFi.
en.title: Frontier Airlines begins retrofitting aircraft, sets first class launch for early March

body: 邊疆航空宣布新的頭等艙將於2027年3月5日推出，客艙改裝已於本月展開，每架飛機將裝設8張新的頭等艙座椅，並在每個座位加裝電源插座與Starlink無線網路。這項消息來自一份外洩的內部文件，該文件由View From The Wing披露；每架飛機的頭等艙座椅採2-2布局、位於機艙前兩排，邊疆航空機隊全數為空中巴士A320系列飛機，並持續接收A320neo與A321neo新機。
在正式上線之前，改裝完成的飛機將以UpFront Plus名義販售頭等艙座位，但直到正式推出前都不會改變客艙服務內容；文件訊息顯示，UpFront Plus產品將走入歷史。改裝期間，邊疆航空的座位頁面會告知旅客前方座位是新的頭等艙，還是舊的UpFront Plus，也就是一排標準經濟艙座椅、腿部空間較大且中間座位保留空位。
頭等艙座椅由Geven提供，採用Comoda型號、寬21英寸，曾在漢堡的飛機內飾博覽會首度展出；邊疆航空原本在2024年宣布推出新頭等艙、預定2025年問世，但計畫已經延後。至於Starlink的收費方式尚未公布，文件也未說明電源插座的型式；美國競爭對手西南航空與聯合航空則透過常客計畫會員贊助的方式免費提供Starlink。
zh.summary: 邊疆航空宣布新頭等艙將於2027年3月5日推出，改裝本月展開，每架飛機將裝設8張頭等艙座椅，並在每個座位加裝電源插座與Starlink無線網路。
zh.title: 邊疆航空開始改裝客機、頭等艙2027年3月初上線
